review.notes: Automated line-level comparison of extracted text from all 23 physical PDF pages against the OCR Markdown, plus a code-fence balance scan (no fences present) and a heading scan (all headings match numbered sections; no figure banners or speaker labels promoted). Page 7 tool chat template prompt boxes and the page 1 teaser table exist only inside embedded figure images (Figures 1 and 4), so their text is not transcribable body text. Footers of pages 3, 5, 10, 13, 19 and 23 were rendered at 300 dpi and visually read to transcribe all seven dropped footnote bodies; page 19 also confirmed the printed spelling "quantitively". Table cell gluing was not exhaustively re-checked cell by cell.
